title: Meta expands subscription push with new AI-focused plans
slides: Can Meta's new AI plans make you pay?
Subscription push expands beyond ad-free browsing
Free users may soon hit AI-powered paywalls
Check if your favorite features move behind a plan
Test one paid AI tool before committing
thread_text:
1. The AI Paywall Is Coming

Meta is reportedly exploring subscriptions for AI features, moving beyond ad-free browsing. Free users could soon face limits on what they can access.

2. No More Free AI Perks

Meta's new subscription push expands beyond ad-free browsing to potentially include AI-powered tools. Users may need to pay for features they currently enjoy for free.

3. AI Paywalls for All?

If Meta follows through, free users could hit AI-powered paywalls. This could set a precedent for other platforms to charge for AI capabilities.

4. Check Your Favorite Features

Some features might move behind a premium plan. It's worth reviewing which AI tools you rely on and whether they'll stay free.

5. Test Before You Commit

Before paying for any AI subscription, try one paid tool for a month. See if it's worth the cost for your needs.
